name: lean
description: omp-style token savers and guards: hashline edits, trimmed tool output, a Haiku scout agent, checks after each edit, pattern rules, push and mount guards, and a /lean report

diagnostics.title: Check files after each edit
diagnostics.description: After Edit, Write or HashEdit, run a fast checker for the file type (ruff for Python syntax and undefined names, bash -n, JSON parse) and hand Claude any errors

advisorModel.title: Advisor model
advisorModel.description: A second model (an alias such as opus or sonnet, or a full id) that reviews each finished turn and hands the agent a concern or blocker before it stops. Costs one extra request per turn. Empty turns the advisor off

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON array of pattern rules applied to every tool call (a project's .claude/lean-rules.json is read too). Empty: project rules only

trimChars.title: Trim output over (characters)
trimChars.description: Bash and Grep output longer than this keeps its head and tail; the full text is saved to a file

protectBranch.title: Protected branch
protectBranch.description: Refuse git pushes to this branch (for example main, where a push deploys). Empty turns the guard off

pushNote.title: Why the branch is protected
pushNote.description: Shown to Claude when a push is refused, for example: a push to main deploys

mountGuardPath.title: Compose folder to guard
mountGuardPath.description: Refuse single-file bind mounts in YAML files whose path contains this, for example deploy/compose/. Empty turns the guard off
